name: application-screening-agent
description: An AI agent that screens job applications with tool calls, guardrails and human approval for rejections.

scripts.screen:samples: rm -f sample-output/audit.jsonl sample-output/decisions.json sample-output/transcript.log sample-output/summary.md && npm run screen -- --out sample-output
scripts.screen:redteam: rm -rf sample-output/redteam && npm run screen -- --file samples/adversarial.json --out sample-output/redteam
scripts.screen:all: npm run screen:samples && npm run screen:redteam
